summary: Master Industrial Planned Maintenance. Learn RCM, TPM, and ISO 55000 strategies to reduce downtime and optimize asset performance. Expert-led 5-day course.
lede: Industrial Planned Maintenance replaces reactive firefighting with a proactive, evidence-based approach to managing assets throughout their life cycle. This course shows you how to align maintenance activities with strategic objectives using asset criticality ranking, preventive maintenance optimization, work order management, and failure mode analysis. You will work with ISO 55000 principles, Reliability Centered Maintenance methods, CMMS workflows, and Root Cause Analysis to structure maintenance decisions around evidence. You will also create maintenance schedules, spare parts plans, and performance dashboards while using measures such as OEE, maintenance backlog hours, and spare parts turnover to demonstrate improvement.
audienceIntro: This program is curated for professionals responsible for the reliability and throughput of industrial assets who need to transition from reactive to proactive operational models.
audience: Asset Management Specialist focused on life cycle
modules: Total Productive Maintenance and Autonomous Action
CMMS Digital Integration and Data Governance
MRO Spare Parts and Inventory Management
Root Cause Analysis and Failure Elimination
Measuring Performance with OEE and KPIs
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or facilities environment. Familiarity with basic maintenance terminology and standard work order processes is recommended. No prior CMMS software expertise is required, though a basic understanding of spreadsheet software for data analysis exercises is beneficial.
